title: SpectraQuant run manifest
description: Machine-readable record of one executed run. Every field is either measured or explicitly null; no field may be filled with an estimate. measurement_class labels the reported numbers per AGENTS.md section 5 and is null only for runs that declare no compression (method="none").

schema_version.description: Manifest schema revision this document validates against.

run_id.description: Unique, filesystem-safe identifier of this run.

timestamp_utc.description: UTC start time, ISO 8601 with a Z suffix.

git_commit.description: Full 40-character SHA of HEAD, or null when not inside a git checkout.

git_dirty.description: True when the working tree had uncommitted tracked changes; null when unknown.

config_path.description: Absolute path of the experiment config that was composed.

resolved_config.description: Fully resolved Hydra config (all defaults merged, all interpolations resolved).

model_id.description: Model identifier, e.g. an HF repo id; null for locally defined models.

model_revision.description: Immutable model revision (commit/tag) or a content hash for local models.

dataset_revisions.description: Revision per dataset, parallel to dataset_ids.

dataset_checksums.description: Content checksums, parallel to dataset_ids. Format: sha256:<64 hex>.

split.description: Split the reported metrics come from (train/val/test/...).

seed.description: Master seed passed to the deterministic seeding routine.

software.description: Version per dependency; null means the distribution is not installed.

compression.description: Compression actually applied. method="none" means an uncompressed baseline. The byte fields (accounted_bytes, measured_bytes, serializer, nominal/measured_bits_per_param, bytes_source) exist so two arms can be gated at equal memory: see src/spectraquant/reporting/comparability.py and AGENTS.md section 4.5.

ranks.description: Per-layer or global rank budget; null when not applicable.

bits.description: Target bit width; null when not applicable.

group_size.description: Quantization group size; null when not applicable.

accounted_bytes.description: Analytical (class 1) stored size in bytes implied by the compression plan, including scales, zero points, group metadata, padding and alignment (AGENTS.md section 5). Defined per (shape, spec) pair, so a model-level value MUST be the sum over layers. It MUST NOT be reported as measured bytes (AGENTS.md section 4.13; docs/protocols/memory-accounting.md section 6). Null when no plan was costed.

measured_bytes.description: Measured (class 3) serialized size in bytes of the compressed weights as written by compression.serializer. Null when nothing was serialized.

measured_bytes_tolerance.description: Predeclared equal-memory tolerance for this arm: either an absolute byte count (integer >= 0) or a relative fraction (a number strictly between 0 and 1) of the larger of the two compared byte totals. Integer values are always absolute bytes; null when this arm declares no tolerance.

serializer.description: Frozen serializer invocation identifier that produced measured_bytes. For SpectraQuant's own container this is spectraquant.quantization.SQ_CONTAINER_FORMAT_ID (e.g. "spectraquant-sqpack-v1"), optionally suffixed with the invocation parameters when the byte layout depends on them. Two class-3 byte counts are only comparable when the same frozen invocation produced them; required whenever measured_bytes is reported.

nominal_bits_per_param.description: Analytical (class 1) bits per parameter of the compression plan; null when not applicable. Ideal payload only, excluding scales, zero points, padding and container overhead, so it is a LOWER BOUND and not a storage figure. The memory-model counterpart is 8*accounted_bytes/numel; compression.measured_bits_per_param is 8*measured_bytes/numel and is class 3. Never present one under the other's name (AGENTS.md section 4.13).

measured_bits_per_param.description: Measured (class 3) bits per parameter, i.e. 8 * measured_bytes / parameter_count of the compressed tensors; null when nothing was serialized.

bytes_source.description: Which byte figure this run declares as its comparable memory. "measured" = class-3 measured_bytes (requires a non-null measured_bytes and serializer); "accounted" = class-1 accounted_bytes and is only allowed when measured_bytes is null, so a class-3 measurement can never be silently downgraded to the estimate.

theoretical_bits.description: Analytical (class 1) bits per parameter implied by the compression plan; null when no plan exists. Payload only, excluding scales, zero points, padding and container overhead: a LOWER BOUND, never a storage figure, and never to be quoted as measured (AGENTS.md section 4.13; docs/protocols/memory-accounting.md section 6).

packed_bytes.description: Measured (class 3) serialized size of the compressed weights; null when nothing was serialized.

runtime_backend.description: Execution backend that produced the metrics. CUDA backends are never reported from this workstation.

measurement_class.description: 1-5 per AGENTS.md section 5; null only when compression.method == "none".

peak_mem_mb.description: Peak process resident memory during the run, MiB (null if unmeasurable).

metrics.description: Measured metrics. Numbers must carry the measurement_class of this manifest.

log_path.description: Path to the captured run log, or null when the run was not logged to a file.

artifact_paths.description: Paths of artifacts written by the run (checkpoints, tables, figures).
